title: Nehemiah Sent to Jerusalem

questions.question: Which king did Nehemiah serve?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:1 (ESV): "In the month of Nisan, in the twentieth year of King Artaxerxes..."

questions.question: Why was the king concerned about Nehemiah?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:2 (ESV): "...Why is your face sad, seeing you are not sick? This is nothing but sadness of the heart."

questions.question: What did Nehemiah ask the king for permission to do?
options: Send me to Judah... that I may rebuild it
questions.correctAnswer: Send me to Judah... that I may rebuild it
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:5 (ESV): "...that you send me to Judah, to the city of my fathers' graves, that I may rebuild it."

questions.question: Who was sitting beside the king when Nehemiah made his request?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:6 (ESV): "And the king said to me (the queen sitting beside him)..."

questions.question: Who were the two officials displeased with Nehemiah’s arrival?
options: Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite
questions.correctAnswer: Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:10 (ESV): "But when Sanballat the Horonite and Tobiah the Ammonite servant heard this..."

questions.question: To whom did Nehemiah need letters for safe passage?
options: The governors of the province Beyond the River
questions.correctAnswer: The governors of the province Beyond the River
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:7 (ESV): "...letters to the governors of the province Beyond the River..."

questions.question: Who was the keeper of the king's forest?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:8 (ESV): "...and a letter to Asaph, the keeper of the king's forest..."

questions.question: How long was Nehemiah in Jerusalem before he inspected the walls?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:11 (ESV): "So I went to Jerusalem and was there three days."

questions.question: What animal did Nehemiah ride during his inspection?
options: The animal on which I rode (likely a donkey or mule)
questions.correctAnswer: The animal on which I rode (likely a donkey or mule)
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:12 (ESV): "...except the animal on which I rode."

questions.question: Which gate did Nehemiah go out by at night?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:13 (ESV): "I went out by night by the Valley Gate..."

questions.question: Why could Nehemiah's mount not pass in one place?
options: There was no place for the animal... to pass
questions.correctAnswer: There was no place for the animal... to pass
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:14 (ESV): "...but there was no place for the animal that was under me to pass."

questions.question: What was the specific motivation Nehemiah shared with the Jews to build the wall?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:17 (ESV): "...Come, let us build the wall of Jerusalem, that we may no longer suffer derision."

questions.question: Who is the third enemy mentioned joining Sanballat and Tobiah?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:19 (ESV): "But when Sanballat... and Geshem the Arab heard of it..."

questions.question: What claim did Nehemiah define for the enemies in Jerusalem?
options: You have no portion or right or claim in Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: You have no portion or right or claim in Jerusalem
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:20 (ESV): "...but you have no portion or right or claim in Jerusalem."

questions.question: What accusation did the enemies make against Nehemiah?
options: Are you rebelling against the king?
questions.correctAnswer: Are you rebelling against the king?
questions.explanation: Nehemiah 2:19 (ESV): "...Are you rebelling against the king?"

key_verse_text: And I told them of the hand of my God that had been upon me for good, and also of the words that the king had spoken to me. And they said, “Let us rise up and build.” So they strengthened their hands for the good work.
